name: openspec-verify-change
description: Verifies that an implementation matches its OpenSpec change's artifacts — completeness (tasks, spec coverage), correctness (requirement and scenario coverage), and coherence (design adherence, pattern consistency) — post-implementation, before archiving. Use for "verify this change", "does the code match the spec", or "is this ready to archive". For pre- implementation artifact-to-artifact consistency, use openspec-audit-change instead.
